review: 702.64b-1: three_blockers was labelled does_not_fire although absorb still applied per source and only the damage total changed; replaced it with one_source, a 4/4 Rumbling Baloth blocking alone, which deals the same total from one source and kills the Sliver.

702.64b-2: two Shocks are two different sources, so it never showed the same source dealing damage at a different time; rewrote it as Lymph Sliver blocking double-striking Mirran Crusader, contrasted with a non-double-striking 4/4 Rumbling Baloth.

scenarios.title: Absorb N prevents N of the damage dealt to the creature
decisions: A casts Shock targeting B's Lymph Sliver, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: shock_on_sliver
variants.expected: Absorb 1 prevents 1 of Shock's 2 damage. Lymph Sliver has 1 damage marked and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: one_damage_source
variants.delta: A activates Prodigal Sorcerer ({T}: 1 damage) targeting Lymph Sliver instead of casting Shock.
variants.expected: Absorb 1 prevents the whole 1 damage. Lymph Sliver has 0 damage marked.

variants.label: no_absorb
variants.delta: Shock targets B's Grizzly Bears (which has no absorb) instead of Lymph Sliver.
variants.expected: No damage is prevented. Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Absorb applies separately to each damage source dealing damage at the same time
decisions: A attacks player B with Lymph Sliver.
B blocks Lymph Sliver with both Grizzly Bears.
A assigns 2 damage to the first Grizzly Bears and 1 damage to the second. Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_sources
variants.expected: Each Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage and absorb prevents 1 from each, so Lymph Sliver has 2 damage marked and survives. The first Grizzly Bears dies; the second has 1 damage marked and survives.

variants.label: one_source
variants.delta: B blocks Lymph Sliver with Rumbling Baloth alone instead of the two Grizzly Bears, and A assigns all 3 damage to it.
variants.expected: Rumbling Baloth deals 4 damage and absorb prevents only 1 of it, so Lymph Sliver has 3 damage marked and is destroyed. Rumbling Baloth has 3 damage marked and survives.

scenarios.title: Absorb applies afresh to damage from the same source at a different time
decisions: B attacks player A with Mirran Crusader.
A blocks Mirran Crusader with Lymph Sliver.
Combat damage is dealt in the first-strike combat damage step and again in the regular combat damage step.

variants.label: double_strike
variants.expected: Mirran Crusader deals 2 damage in each of the two combat damage steps and absorb prevents 1 each time, so Lymph Sliver has 2 damage marked and survives. Mirran Crusader is dealt 3 damage in the regular step and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: single_hit
variants.delta: B attacks with Rumbling Baloth (4/4, no double strike) instead of Mirran Crusader.
variants.expected: Rumbling Baloth deals 4 damage at one time and absorb prevents only 1 of it, so Lymph Sliver has 3 damage marked and is destroyed. Rumbling Baloth has 3 damage marked and survives.

scenarios.title: Multiple absorb instances each apply separately
decisions: A casts Shock targeting one of B's Lymph Slivers, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Each Lymph Sliver grants absorb 1, so the target has two instances of absorb 1. Both apply and prevent 2 damage in total. The target has 0 damage marked.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: B controls only one Lymph Sliver.
variants.expected: The target has one instance of absorb 1, which prevents 1 damage. The Lymph Sliver has 1 damage marked.
